name: BRAND TEXT
description:
Almost Heaven Saunas is a US industry leader and has a vast experience of 40 years in manufacturing hand-crafted home saunas that are not only beautiful, but also very effective and trustworthy. Their sauna units are durable, high quality and are available with various custom options on the market to answer any taste and wallet.



A Radiant Series Infrared Sauna is built from top quality lumber on your choice, such as: Hemlock-Fir, Clear Western Red Cedar, and Rustic Western Red Cedar. This, together with an extra-wide triple layer carbon fiber heating panels with low EMF will provide a relaxing session in long-wave warmth that is very similar to the sun’s heat but without the harmful side effects of the UV. Customization will enable to make a personalized unit for each home to make it a perfect retreat from all the stresses of the world for every customer.



Tempered glass and stainless steel hinges, top grade experts that understand the features of every lumber used in the making of the sauna – all this and so much more make these sauna units exceptionally safe and effective in every way. Almost Heaven Saunas – the Authentic sauna experience.
